title: osf work-tracker command group
summary: Adds an `osf work-tracker` CLI group with two subcommands: `ready` reads the single GitHub Project item whose status is Ready, and `report` writes a state (in-progress, in-review, failed, blocked+cause) plus a recap file back to one item. A new `[work_tracker]` table in the repository's `osf.toml` (owner, project_number, optional status_field and skip_status) configures the GitHub adapter; the general config loader now strips that table so it does not trip `deny_unknown_fields`. The command layer is thin: it parses arguments, builds a real `GitHubWorkTracker` over the `gh` CLI, and delegates to the existing `work_tracker::ready` and `work_tracker::report` modules.
